CHATTYVAKUUSEARRING-ALLOW_WHISPERING_WIT: Allow Vakuu to Speak Without the Earring

Enables Vakuu's speech even if you don't have the Whispering Earring.
The relic's effects, and any dialogue caused by those effects, will not occur.
CHATTYVAKUUSEARRING-SPEECH_DURATION_MULT:
Extends how long Vakuu's speech bubbles stay on screen by this multiplier.
If you feel you don't get enough time to read the dialogue, increase it further.
CHATTYVAKUUSEARRING-BUBBLE_IN_FRONT_OF_C: Show Speech Bubbles in Front of Cards

Shows Vakuu's speech bubbles during combat in front of the card being played.
When turned off, they may end up hidden behind cards.
CHATTYVAKUUSEARRING-RAISE_BUBBLE.title: Show Speech Bubbles Slightly Higher
CHATTYVAKUUSEARRING-RAISE_BUBBLE.hover.d:
Shifts Vakuu's combat speech bubbles slightly upward.
Use this if you dislike either a bubble covering the card being played or a bubble being hidden behind it.
